# connection_admission

:::info[Typed specification]

Generated by the pinned `ess generate --kind docs` from [`ess`](https://github.com/beyond10x/connectors/tree/main/ess). Structural validation establishes consistency; behaviour, storage and cross-record predicates remain implementation obligations.

Proposed connection viability, request eligibility and host management target values; no runtime checker or persistent connection lifecycle.

`connectors.connection_admission` is one of connectors's bounded contexts. [Back to the index](../index.md).

## Types

### `ConnectionState`

`connectors.connection_admission.ConnectionState` is one of `pending`, `ready`, `reauthorization_required`, `custody_unavailable`, `parent_degraded`, `disabled` and `revoked`.

### `EligibilityDecision`

`connectors.connection_admission.EligibilityDecision` is a record of two fields:

- `eligible` — `Boolean`
- `error` — `Optional<connectors.service_wire.ErrorCode>`, which may be absent

### `EligibilityFacts`

`connectors.connection_admission.EligibilityFacts` is a record of eight fields:

- `authority_available` — `Boolean`
- `host_admitted` — `Boolean`
- `operation_enabled` — `Boolean`
- `viability` — `connectors.connection_admission.ViabilityDecision`
- `profile_matches` — `Boolean`
- `scope` — `connectors.connection_admission.RequirementResult`
- `permission` — `connectors.connection_admission.RequirementResult`
- `verification` — `connectors.connection_admission.RequirementResult`

### `EvidenceRequirements`

`connectors.connection_admission.EvidenceRequirements` is a record of two fields:

- `connection` — `List<connectors.credential_evidence.CheckKind>`
- `operations` — `List<connectors.connection_admission.OperationCheckRequirements>`

### `ManagementAction`

`connectors.connection_admission.ManagementAction` is one of `list`, `describe`, `begin_create`, `begin_repair`, `status`, `revoke` and `protected_complete`.

### `ManagementTarget`

`connectors.connection_admission.ManagementTarget` is a record of six fields:

- `owning_instance` — `String`
- `kind` — `connectors.connection_admission.ManagementTargetKind`
- `profile` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `connection` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `acquisition` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent
- `expected_revision` — `Optional<String>`, which may be absent

### `ManagementTargetKind`

`connectors.connection_admission.ManagementTargetKind` is one of `instance`, `connection` and `acquisition`.

### `NextAction`

`connectors.connection_admission.NextAction` is one of `reconnect` and `revalidate`.

### `OperationCheckRequirements`

`connectors.connection_admission.OperationCheckRequirements` is a record of two fields:

- `operation` — `String`
- `checks` — `List<connectors.credential_evidence.CheckKind>`

### `RequirementResult`

`connectors.connection_admission.RequirementResult` is one of `not_required`, `satisfied`, `insufficient`, `denied`, `unavailable`, `stale` and `unknown`.

### `StatusObservation`

`connectors.connection_admission.StatusObservation` is a record of five fields:

- `state` — `connectors.connection_admission.ConnectionState`
- `since` — `Timestamp`
- `observed_at` — `Timestamp`
- `valid_until` — `Timestamp`
- `next_action` — `Optional<connectors.connection_admission.NextAction>`, which may be absent

### `ViabilityDecision`

`connectors.connection_admission.ViabilityDecision` is a record of two fields:

- `state` — `Optional<connectors.connection_admission.ConnectionState>`, which may be absent
- `error` — `Optional<connectors.service_wire.BaseErrorCode>`, which may be absent

### `ViabilityFacts`

`connectors.connection_admission.ViabilityFacts` is a record of eight fields:

- `metadata_available` — `Boolean`
- `locally_revoked` — `Boolean`
- `enabled` — `Boolean`
- `established_credential_failure` — `Boolean`
- `required_custody_available` — `Boolean`
- `required_parent_available` — `Boolean`
- `validated_publication` — `Boolean`
- `baseline_current` — `Boolean`

Six of the types above are reached by nothing else in this system: `connectors.connection_admission.EligibilityDecision`, `connectors.connection_admission.EligibilityFacts`, `connectors.connection_admission.ManagementAction`, `connectors.connection_admission.ManagementTarget`, `connectors.connection_admission.StatusObservation` and `connectors.connection_admission.ViabilityFacts`.
